text:
maya_research: rolled nebula-11b q4a canary to 2% tonight. getting a repeat token loop on long contexts (>2048). example from a user prompt:
```
Prompt: Explain step-by-step how to bake sourdough at home.
Model: Step 1: Mix flour and water. Step 2: Mix flour and water. Step 3: Mix flour and water. Step 4: Mix flour and water....
```
Logs: grpc request id=0x7b9f, kernel=q4a-v1, kv_len=4096, tokens_out=1536, repeated_loop_count=4

evan_serving: saw the same on dedicated canary shard 3. freq ~0.7% of requests when context > 2k, also noticed p50 latency +20% for long tails. :eyes:

jonah_eval: added a failing test to longform-coherence-v2 with that prompt. baseline (fp16) passes, q4a fails with repetition score spike. attaching eval diff id: eval-nebula-long-2026-03-20.

maya_research: initial hunch: kvcache rewind + quant kernel mismatch for certain attention chunking. q4a fused-attn path may be re-using stale KV slices under long splits.

evan_serving: quick mitigation attempted: forced kv-warmup path (1 extra prefix forward) on shard -> reduced frequency to ~0.2% but not gone. CPU offload also increased latency.

sara_engineering: suggestion: try disabling fused_attn for q4a runtime on canary (fall back to reference attn kernels) and rerun cal dataset for quant stats. Also try increasing batch_ks to avoid split boundaries.

jonah_eval: ran a quick ablation overnight: q4a + fused_attn = repeat; q4a + fused_attn off = much lower repeats; fp16 (no quant) = no repeats. saving detailed logs to s3://redwood-dev/nebula/onboard/repro/2210456789.tar.gz

ops-bot: Canary deployment 2210456700 started -> 2% traffic to nebula-11b-q4a-canary.

maya_research: can we get a comparison of kernels? evan, which kernel package is the canary using?

evan_serving: canary kernel: infer-kernel-1.9.2, fallback tested with infer-kernel-1.8.7 shows lower repeats in quick test.

sara_engineering: filing INF-3256: "nebula-11b q4a kvcache repeat under long context" with reproducer and priority P2. Link: https://tickets.redwood/INF-3256

maya_research: plan: 1) immediate -> disable fused_attn on canary and re-evaluate 2) short -> run full calibration with larger calibration set (64k examples) and try symmetric quant mapping 3) medium -> instrument kvcache boundary guards and add unit test for attention chunk overlap 4) fallback -> rollback to fp16 canary if repeats persist.

evan_serving: going to flip fused_attn off on canary branch and run smoke. will post results in 10m.

jonah_eval: also recommend adding the new prompt set to our regression watchlist and alerting product teams if earlier regressions reappear.

maya_research: assigning ownership to myself for triage + PRs. will push repro script and a minimal unit test by EOD. tagging @sara_engineering for infra ticket follow-up.

sara_engineering: got it. created infra subtask to add kernel downgrade rollback hook and canary monitor threshold adjustments.

evan_serving: quick update: fused_attn disabled on canary -> after 30m observed repeats drop to near zero on sampled traffic. p50 latency for long requests improved slightly (down ~10% from canary baseline), p95 still elevated vs fp16.

maya_research: nice. next steps: run the longer eval sweep (2k samples) overnight, confirm no quality regression vs fp16, measure cost delta. if green, we'll broaden canary to 10% then full rollout with new kernel pinned.

jonah_eval: started sweep job eval-nebula-long-2026-03-21-overnight. will post diff with metrics: repetition_rate, coherence_score, perplexity.

ops-bot: Incident monitor: repetition_rate for nebula-11b-q4a exceeded threshold at 2210456842 -> alert created.

maya_research: thanks everyone. I'll update ticket INF-3256 with repro artifacts and a recommended mitigation (disable fused_attn + longer quant calibration) and CTA for rollout plan.

sara_engineering: :thumbsup: please add a note for support to temporary route customers to fp16 if they see noisy outputs until we confirm canary stability.

maya_research: will do. EOD update scheduled.
